messages:

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding grant appearing on our invoice (VAT/charge)

Hi team,

We just pulled our August invoice and see a line that looks like the onboarding grant we received when signing up. The invoice (INV-20260825) lists a credit-type line but then shows VAT applied and a net charge. In short: we expected the free onboarding credits to zero out usage, not show up as a billed line with tax. Can you confirm whether the promo credits were actually applied or if we were charged in error?

I attached the relevant PDF from our billing portal.

Thanks,
Ellie

Hi Ellie — thanks for flagging this and for the invoice PDF.

Short answer: that is not expected behavior for standard PLG onboarding grants. The grant should show as a credit balance in the billing portal and not produce a VAT-chargeable invoice line that results in a net amount due.

I'm looping in Ben and Kimberly from Sales & Billing so we can triage quickly. Two quick asks while we investigate:
- Can you confirm the billing contact (is billing@cloudwave.io the correct address to receive credits reversal)?
- Do you have a VAT number on file for Cloudwave Inc? If not, we may need to reclassify the tax treatment.

We'll review the invoice and the backend ledger and come back with a correction or credit.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[internal note: possible tax mis-tag or portal UI bug where promo credits were emitted as negative line but still taxed]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Torres <ellie@cloudwave.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding grant appearing on our invoice (VAT/charge)

Ellie — I dug into the invoice record. It looks like during the automated billing run on 2026-08-25 our system emitted the onboarding grant as a negative usage line (promo_grant_5842) but a downstream tax calculation job incorrectly considered the negative line when computing VAT base, producing a small VAT amount (~$43) and leaving a net balance.

Plan:
1) We will issue a correcting credit memo that reverses the VAT and the negative invoice line; the net effect will be $0 due for the onboarding period.
2) If Cloudwave needs immediate cash adjustment, we can issue a one-time invoice credit now and follow with the ledger correction.
3) Engineering has a ticket to prevent negative lines from being included in tax calc: SUP-2197.

I will open the credit now and confirm once posted. Apologies for the confusion.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
[attachment: promo-grant-snapshot.png (image/png)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding grant appearing on our invoice (VAT/charge)

Ellie — quick update: we created CM-20260830-5842 (credit memo) to reverse the VAT and the erroneous net amount. That should reflect on your account and in the portal within 24 hours.

If you prefer a trial extension in lieu of the monetary credit (to keep the billing clean and avoid tax reclassification on your records), I'm authorized to grant an additional 30 days of onboarding credits equal to the disputed amount — let me know which you prefer.

Also, if you can confirm the VAT number (or confirm you don't have one), Monica will push the reclassification so the tax doesn't reappear on future promo lines.

Thanks for your patience.
Kimberly Park
